name: Ayakashi
source:
[spoiler][url=/c281]Kisaragi Soushichi's[/url] form during Touko's route in Ayakashibito when he's forced to make a contract with [url=/c365]Hounan[/url] in order to survive. It's a complete opposite of his normal personality; he feels an urge to destroy everything in his path.
Wears a 2 meter long really destructive spiral sword. Besides the sword, there's 8 gun grown out from his back which can fire bullets he made within his own body.[/spoiler]
